items.description: Trump says "status quo" is what Gulf Arab allies want as Iran war hits stalemate and midterms force pivot from threats of attacks to economic pressure

items.title: Pope meets five clerical abuse victims in Argentina
items.description: Pontiff met with five victims of clerical abuse in Argentina during short stay i Buenos Aires; Leo vows to strengthen protection measures within the Catholic Church. Leer más

items.title: As the world's calamities converge climate talks tread water
items.description: Pragmatists concede that the process of annual international talks on climate change feels like it is, at best, treading water for now.

items.title: Why the integration of immigrants in Germany remains a challenge
items.description: The Federal Office for Migration and Refugees has released a new Integration Report. It found that while the integration of people with a migrant background is improving, violent youth remain a problem.

items.title: Europe warned against falling for Russia's 'traps' on Ukraine talks
items.description: The hawkish former Prime Minister of Estonia Kaja Kallas said it was not up to Russia to decide who would represent Europe

items.title: Democracy study: One-quarter of Germans want a right-wing authoritarian dictatorship
items.description: The far-right AfD's electoral successes point to a new trend in Germany: Prejudice, resentment, and extremism are on the rise. A new study suggests satisfaction with democracy is at a low ebb.

items.title: Pope Leo urges Latin American unity during visit to Argentina
items.description: Pope Leo urges Javier Milei to maintain Latin American unity, a reference to turmoil with Brazil, during his first speech in Buenos Aires. Leer más

items.title: Ukraine claims record 3,000 Russian casualties in one day as war drags on
items.description: Meanwhile, Russia appears to suggest it has control of half of unoccupied Donbas.

items.title: Czechia braces for massive protest against public media reform plans
items.description: A fast-tracked bill to cut public media funding has sparked strikes, rallies and fears for the independence of public broadcasting in Czechia. A massive protest is planned for Prague on Sunday.

items.title: Beijing faces its Russia dilemma amid talk of Xi-Trump-Putin summit
items.description: China is forced to tread carefully as it considers hosting a meeting between Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump. While the optics are sure to favor Moscow, Beijing is risking its image at the global stage.

items.title: Drought threatens Iraq's marshes, risking one of the oldest ways of life
items.description: The unique marshes of southern Iraq are beginning to revive after five years of devastating drought. But challenges remain for one of the world's oldest ways of life.

items.title: China warns against fresh US chip curbs
items.description: China has warned the US against imposing additional export controls on AI chips.

items.title: British counterterrorism police arrest US soldier accused of spying on behalf of Russia
items.description: A member of the US Army has been arrested near Gloucester in England. Police said he was suspected of espionage activity in connection with Russia. Investigators from the US and UK are involved in the probe.
